tips.description:
Fix:
TFT Mobile fixed an issue where "Nidalee" in spell form occasionally kept the empowered basic attack state until the end of combat
TFT fixed an issue where "Nidalee" in spell form occasionally kept the empowered basic attack animation but dealt no damage until the end of combat
Mobile vs. PC Difference:
PC: If "Nidalee" is crowd-controlled during her human-form ability, she only performs the ability animation for the rest of the round but can't throw the javelin, can't basic attack to gain mana, and deals no damage
Mobile: If "Nidalee" is crowd-controlled during her human-form ability, she only performs the ability for the rest of the round but can still throw the ability javelin, enabling infinite ability casts

tips.description: If Nidalee levels up while in Physical form, the upgraded Nidalee stays in melee form, but her mana bar becomes 45 like Magic form, which is really painful, and unless you switch her back to Magic form, there's no way to remove this downside. The only fix is to unequip items and put her on the bench to clear all Physical bonuses. If you only use melee-specific transformation items, you can activate 2Spellweaver to switch to Magic form and then back to Physical form to remove the bug.
tips.author: MOGG

tips.description:
Cloud vs. Tactics difference:
In TFT, when Nidalee's AP and AD are equal, she defaults to magic form, but when carrying Titan's Resolve, Edge of Night, Bloodthirster, or Hand Of Justice (four front-line items), she switches to physical melee form.
In Tactics, when Nidalee's AP and AD are equal, she is always in magic form with no special item synergy.

Mage Warrior innate: 【Mage Warrior】 skills transform based on whichever is higher between physical and magic bonus.
tips.author: 云顶CPU

tips.description:
Mage-warrior units have an innate trait: when either AD or AP scaling exceeds the other, they shift to the corresponding damage role.
If AD and AP scaling are equal, the mage-warrior unit stays in its default form.
Akali, Master Yi, and Kog'Maw default to AD carries.
Tahm Kench and Nidalee default to AP carries.
tips.author: 云顶CPU

tips.description:
How do you get an AD Nidalee when her AD and AP ratios are the same?
1. Activate the Bruiser/Adaptive trait, which defaults to AP
2. Give her a Storm B.F. Sword so AD surpasses AP, making Nidalee scale off AD
3. Build the B.F. Sword fighter items on Nidalee, which are Edge of Night and Bloodthirster
4. As long as you never let AP exceed AD for the rest of the game—like adding Titan's Resolve, Hand Of Justice, etc.—Nidalee will stay AD the whole time
tips.author: 世界赛-Horox

The only fix is to unequip items and put her on the bench to clear all Physical bonuses. If you only use melee-specific transformation items, you can activate 2Spellweaver to switch to Magic form and then back to Physical form to remove the bug.

tips.description:
Cloud vs. Tactics difference:
In TFT, when Nidalee's AP and AD are equal, she defaults to magic form, but when carrying Titan's Resolve, Edge of Night, Bloodthirster, or Hand Of Justice (four front-line items), she switches to physical melee form.
In Tactics, when Nidalee's AP and AD are equal, she is always in magic form with no special item synergy.

Mage Warrior innate: 【Mage Warrior】 skills transform based on whichever is higher between physical and magic bonus.

tips.description:
How do you get an AD Nidalee when her AD and AP ratios are the same?
1. Activate the Bruiser/Adaptive trait, which defaults to AP
2. Give her a Storm B.F. Sword so AD surpasses AP, making Nidalee scale off AD
3. Build the B.F. Sword fighter items on Nidalee, which are Edge of Night and Bloodthirster
4. As long as you never let AP exceed AD for the rest of the game—like adding Titan's Resolve, Hand Of Justice, etc.—Nidalee will stay AD the whole time

16284.core: Comp credits: Yurina, Hermit's Wife, Gentleness. This comp is quite special — it's a 6-roll 3-star comp, but you need to reach level 8 for it to fully come online. Use LeBlanc to copy units, use 3 Blossom to supplement econ, and use multiple 3-stars in the mid game to add strength. If you can reach 8, you have a strong shot at top 2.
16284.open: Econ augments are the prerequisite. Ideally you open with Yunara + 1 Blossom so you can hit 3 Blossom earlier and get the boosted spirit returns.
16284.earlyDesc: The only goal is 3 Blossom + LeBlanc, and start supplementing econ for the comp as early as possible. If you open with Trade Sector, it's recommended to roll once every round, trying to pick up more high-quality spirits.
16284.midDesc: After making sure you're level 6, find at least one high-quality econ spirit every round, and keep enough econ leftover to keep looking for spirits the next round. The mid game has plenty of high-quality spirits that give econ and XP, and with the Blossom boost the returns are very high — keep going until you have 5 three-stars (you don't need Leona and Kayle).
16284.finalDesc: After everything is 3-starred, unless econ allows otherwise, you can keep rolling at level 6-7 for combat power or econ spirits until you get the chance to go 8 and immediately form the final fully online comp. There's basically no room to swap units in this comp — you could say every single one has its own role.
16284.title: 日蚀芸阿娜
